5.  DemoManager.cpp

```cpp
using vendor::tcl::hongxi::V1_0::ISignalCb;

sp<vendor::tcl::hongxi::V1_0::ISignalCb> sigCb = NULL;
...
bool HongxiManager::setCallback(const sp<ISignalCb>& callback) {
	bool bRet = false;
	sigCb = callback;
}
...
//when the signal change we should notify client by this callback.
bool HongxiManager::updateSignal(int32_t status) {
	sigCb.signalEvent(status);
}
...
```
